items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Bob Frank played a pickle. But I had a pickle too.

ctx.x: Not the kind that they play, that Bob Frank played or anything?
Well, no, no. Bob Frank played a pickle. But I had a pickle too. You see?
Did they have keys on it? That's right. Oh, these were real flutes with keys on them. Did you play those with any bands or just by yourself?
